title: Construction of By-pass and Diversion Roads Manila, Cavite Bypass Road, Kawit, Cavite
description: CONSTRUCTION OF BY-PASS AND DIVERSION ROADS   MANILA-CAVITE BYPASS ROAD, STA 27 + 055 - STA 27 + 300, KAWIT, CAVITE
colour_meaning: Look first: an official warning record, or two signs of risk together.
contractor: Bidders: Ed1son Development & Construction Inc. and Waycon Builders and Construction Supply Corp. (For:waycon Builders & Construction Supply)

bidders.name: Waycon Builders and Construction Supply Corp. (For:waycon Builders & Construction Supply)

reasons.title: Price per km above 95% of similar works
reasons.detail: Official budget ₱631.7M per km; the 95th percentile of similar works (Other road project, 339 past contracts) is ₱588.8M per km. Length read from the title: 245 m.
reasons.evidence: In past DPWH road contracts this was linked to about 2.2 times the odds of termination.
checks: Check the stated length against the plans or Bill of Quantities; a wrong length distorts price per km.
Look for items that raise cost but are not road surface: drainage, slope protection, bridges, lighting.
Compare unit prices for the main items (concrete, asphalt) with similar contracts nearby.

reasons.title: A bidder had a contract terminated before
reasons.detail: Ed1son Development & Construction Inc.: 1 of 137 earlier road contracts terminated
reasons.evidence: In past contracts, a winner with an earlier termination had about 2.1 times the odds of another; this held on 2023–2025 data.
checks: Open the terminated contracts listed under Bidders and see why they ended (COA report, DPWH order).
Check whether the firm with the termination record is the winner.

claude_note:
**Claude check (advice only):** The ABC of about 154.8M and the 245 m length (STA 27+055 to 27+300) match the official DPWH record, so the high cost per km is real for such a short stretch; check what the works include.
**Sources:** confirmed on DPWH API (ABC and stationing match; PhilGEPS notice not attached, DPWH budget field shows 0) · **Suggested next step:** check the source by hand
